data.title: Visitor Center Closed on Thur. 11/26 For Holiday
data.description: The Great Sand Dunes Visitor Center and WNP Park Store are closed on Thur. 11/26 for the Thanksgiving Day holiday. All outdoor areas including trails, parking lots, and outdoor restrooms continue to be open.

data.title: Medano Pass Primitive Road Closed for the Season
data.description: As of 8 am November 24, the Medano Pass Primitive Road will be closed for the 2026/2027 winter season between Castle Creek Picnic Area and the preserve boundary at Medano Pass. Anticipated reopening is May 2027. Specific reopening dates will be posted on the park website.

data.title: Speed Limits are Much Lower Inside Park than Surrounding Highways
data.description: Speed limits for the park include 30 MPH near the park boundary and Great Sand Dunes Sign, and as low as 10 MPH near the Headquarters and Entrance Station. Speed limits are in place to protect park visitors, pedestrians, and wildlife in the park. Please drive carefully and responsibly.

data.title: Sand Board and Sand Sled Rentals Not Available In Park.
data.description: Sand boarding and sand sled rentals are located in local communities surrounding the park. Visitors are encouraged to arrange rentals BEFORE coming to the park.

data.title: Piñon Flats Campground, sites can be reserved 3 months in advance for 2026
data.description: Due to the need for improvements in Piñon Flats Campground, sites can be reserved 3 months in advance beginning in 2026.
